cleanup.barriers: Floating barriers along portions of Playa del Carmen, Puerto Morelos, Tulum; coverage varies by season.
cleanup.cleanup: SEMAR vessels, municipal and hotel crews; heaviest-hit region on this list.
cleanup.resort: Resorts employ dedicated sargassum crews, some with private barriers.
cleanup.speed: same-day, but can be overwhelmed at peak

safety.advisory: US State Dept: Quintana Roo, Level 2 (exercise increased caution)
notes: Sargassum peaks May–Aug; decomposing mats release hydrogen sulfide (avoid heavy piles).
